Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished, high-fidelity full-screen Chinese pottery sculpting web app concept, landscape 16:9, ideally 2048x1152. This is one real app screen, not a mood board, not a triptych, no device frame. It is an embedded educational pottery module: absolutely NO logo, NO branding, NO site masthead or top navigation bar. Show the active SCULPTING step, not the initial vessel-selection step; the form was selected on the previous screen, so NO grid of vessel presets and no shape switcher at the same hierarchy as sculpting. Maintain one cohesive material language: warm translucent ivory frosted-glass UI, thin taupe borders, restrained rounded corners, elegant readable dark Chinese Song-style serif for headings and neutral modern text for control labels. No skeuomorphic wood/leather/metal buttons, no green UI, no neon or game HUD. Realistic still-WET unfired clay, warm earthy taupe brown, subtle damp satin highlights, fine grain, faint wheel marks, gentle finger indentations and slight organic asymmetry, open mouth, visible wall thickness, absolutely not white bisque and not shiny glazed porcelain. One modest small jar on a simple thin pottery wheel disk. The vessel is the only necessary live 3D object; all atmosphere must be achievable with a simple flat image or CSS gradient, plus actual vessel lighting and contact shadow. NO built-out 3D workshop, room, shelves, cabinets, furniture, window geometry, plants, extra decorative pottery, disembodied hands or tools. Excellent spacious composition, generous breathing room, quiet editorial premium feel, larger jar unobstructed, all tools and the main action visible without scrolling. Preserve sculpting capabilities in a compact interaction layout: push/pull, local pinching, finger dents, smoothing, height; undo, reset; rotate/zoom. Current form is simply a text label, not a competing selectable gallery. All text concise, sharp, legible simplified Chinese. Exact useful text: "02 / 塑形", "先捏出一件器物", "湿泥 · 可塑形", "推拉", "手捏", "压痕", "抚平", "拉高", "撤销", "复位", "完成塑形，准备素烧 →". Small unobtrusive progress at bottom: "起点 · 塑形 · 装饰 · 烧成 · 成品", emphasize 塑形. Do not write concept titles A/B/C inside the actual interface.
Variant A — airy light studio. Soft warm ivory-to-oat gradient seamless backdrop with a broad faint light bloom. Fine matte shadow beneath a slim pale neutral wheel disk, no horizon line. Large hand-pinched round small jar centered at approximately 40% of screen width, making it the clear hero with soft daylight from upper left and gentle shadow falloff. Right compact floating frosted-glass panel, comfortably readable, around 25% screen width: heading, two restrained sentences, single text current form label "小罐 · 自由塑形", modest geometric measures, a short "局部力度" slider. Five sculpt-tool icons with Chinese labels sit together in ONE elegant shallow floating strip beneath the vessel, selected 手捏 lightly tinted muted taupe. Undo and reset small at the end. A discreet radius slider floats at the left edge of the canvas. Main action at panel bottom. Bottom right a tiny view control for "旋转" and a zoom slider. Think premium minimalist creative software with natural ceramic tactility, almost photographic art direction, not a beige administrative dashboard.
